credits: Worlds generated with World Labs Marble (marble-1.1-plus) through the World API; drawn in ink by the page.
Measured half: a 360 camera, COLMAP and LichtFeld Studio. Rendered with Spark.

captions.label: Part 2
captions.text: What moves the line? Marble, shown one photo of my room.

captions.label: 1 photo
captions.text: Photograph where the photo saw. Everything in ink, Marble made up.

captions.label: 4 photos
captions.text: Four photos from the same spot. It makes up less of the room.

captions.label: 8 photos
captions.text: Eight, laid out by Marble itself. Less again.

captions.label: The 360 still
captions.text: Shown the whole room, it keeps the most.

captions.label: The 360 still
captions.text: Where even this turns to ink, the world and my scan disagree, often through the scan's own error.

captions.label: Red pen
captions.text: Red marks invention that lands away from the room.

captions.label: Red pen
captions.text: More photos shrink what Marble makes up. They don't make what it makes up true.
